srList.sentence: Further details on the design of the Dutch Diabetes Pearl have been published previously. 22 People were eligible for participation if they were diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and received secondary or tertiary care in one of the academic medical centres of Amsterdam, Utrecht, Nijmegen, Rotterdam, Leiden or Groningen, if they received primary medical care in the area of Hoorn, or if they received primary, secondary or tertiary care in the area of Maastricht.
